description: List journeys stored on this self-host instance. A journey is a collection of quote snapshots that build up to a complete sold (bound) journey: every quote saved with the same `journey_reference` (any string unique to the journey, e.g. an application or state-machine id) is a snapshot of the case at that point. The journey is complete when its latest quote is `sold`; until then it is in progress. One row per journey_reference, most recently active first. Each row is the journey's latest quote in the get_quotes shape (`result`, `valid`, `amended_result`, `amended_valid`, `sold`, …) plus `start_date` and `end_date` (its first and last quote's created_at), `quote_count`, `quotes` (`[{ quote_reference, created_at, quoted_by, source }]`, oldest first: who — a person, an AI agent or an integration — ran each snapshot, and through api or mcp) and `journey_url` (the dashboard's view of it). Quotes saved without a journey_reference belong to no journey. Filter by `project_reference` (only that project's quotes count), `since` (ISO date; journeys with a quote since then) or `search` (text match on journey_reference). Paged with `limit` (default 25, max 100) and `offset`; `has_more` says whether another page exists. Returns `{ count, limit, offset, has_more, journeys: [...], next_steps }`. Call get_journey for one journey's quotes in full.

offset.description: Optional. Rows to skip, for paging.

project_reference.description: Optional. Only this project's quotes (get_projects lists them).

search.description: Optional. Text to match in the journey_reference.

since.description: Optional. ISO date or date-time; only journeys with a quote at or after it.

name: get_journeys
